newsitem.title: USA: Bass group raises Lindsay stake to 14.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bass group raises Lindsay stake to 14.8 pct.

text.p: A group including members of the wealthy Bass family of Fort Worth, Texas, said on Monday it raised its stake in Lindsay Manufacturing Co to 14.8 percent or 935,299 common shares.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it bought 48,800 additional shares between December 2 and 9 at prices ranging from $40.50 to $41.54 a share.
The group previously held a 13.6 percent stake in Lindsay, a Lindsay, Neb.,-based manufacturer of irrigation systems and special metal products.
The group said it is filing with antitrust regulators for authority to buy more than $15 million, but not more than 15 percent, of Linday's common stock outstanding.
